component.name: AniMe Matrix
component.summary: Control the LED display of the ROG Strix Flare II Animate keyboard

description.p: AniMe Matrix drives the 312-LED AniMe Matrix display of the ASUS ROG Strix Flare II Animate keyboard (USB 0b05:19fc).

ul.li: GIF, image and video gallery, clock faces (digital, analog, binary, in words), free text in any direction
Effects and audio visualizers, playable games, system monitor, now playing, desktop notifications
Playlists and favorites, schedule and per-application profiles, status lights (microphone, webcam, OBS)
Animation editor, community library, faithful preview, web remote for your phone

description.p: The udev rule giving access to the keyboard must be installed on the host: see the project page.
After a package update, the daemon's systemd unit is reloaded before the daemon restarts, so changes to the unit (such as returning the fans to the firmware after a crash) take effect.

PC fan control: motherboard (Nuvoton nct67xx), NVIDIA cards and Corsair HXi / RMi power supplies, automatic, fixed speed or temperature curve, with safeguards. New command: animematrix-ctl infos (keyboard firmware and layout).
Launcher: fixes the crash when closing the round interfaces with their ✕ button.
Launcher: fixes a possible crash when closing the window (Tk font cache); crash traces are saved to ~/.cache/animematrix/plantages.log.
Screen mirror under Wayland: the chosen screen or window is remembered, and a window can be mirrored through the portal.
Typing glow on the keys, status lights on F1-F3, key flash on notifications, every key recognised (function keys, arrows, keypad), settings backup and restore.
Key-by-key colour editor, the six built-in keyboard animations, live preview of the stored animation, problems shown in the launcher and the web remote.
Keys follow the screen or the music; key colours per time slot and per application; the screen really switches off when locked or asleep.
Security fixes: local HTTP API protected from web pages, web remote limited to safe commands, verified updates, library entries checked.
After an update, the running daemon is restarted with the new version (keyboard colours reported the keyboard as unreachable).
Key colours and effects without OpenRGB: rainbow, static, breathing, ripple and more, saved in the keyboard; theme colour and pulse with the screen.
On-board memory: save an animation in the keyboard, shown without any software; hardware brightness.
Wayland, playlists, profiles, status lights, videos, webcam, screen mirror, web remote, new clock faces and games.
System monitor and games reachable again.
